Review of head 106f4c314. Built review: ran the suites locally in a worktree.

**Gate result: green.**
- `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib`: 1208 passed, 0 failed, 4 ignored.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui -p camcraft-app -- -D warnings`: clean.

**Staleness check (the four inputs):**
- A path edit: the key holds `Toolpath::path_sig`, the move count and the warnings. `Toolpath::new` is the only way to build a cache (the `sig` field is private), and it computes the sig from the moves. I checked every write site of the `Toolpath` component: `create.rs`, `generate.rs` and the project loader all build through `new`. `fixture_route::splice` and `finish_clip` edit the moves of an owned copy, but their output folds back into `run_job`, and `generate.rs:97` rebuilds through `new`. No in-place edit can leave a stale sig.
- The dim: it is in the `Look` key. `path_overlay_tests::each_changed_input_builds_exactly_once` pins it.
- The palette and the theme ground: both are in the `Look` key.
- A model change: the lines do not read the model. The chevron arm keys on each model's facet allocation, length and pose. `solid_world_aabb` reads only those inputs, so the key covers the function. The test pins a new model: one arm measure, one line rebuild.
- A region: the key is the operation value plus `operation::op_stamp`. `current_stamp` digests the tool, the parameters, the source pose and the `geometry_signature`, the stock, the setup, the alignment and the WCS. A gone source gives `None`, and a `None` stamp is never kept. Correct.

**Notes (no action needed):**
- `keep_only` drops the entries of paths over the vertex budget; the next frame rebuilds them. This is churn on a truncated multi-path frame, not a wrong picture.
- The arm key compares a `Weak` allocation pointer. A freed-and-reallocated body at the same address with the same length and pose would read fresh. The chance is negligible, and the cost is one chevron size.

**Blocker: the PR body is empty.**
The body must say what changed, name the pinning tests, carry the `Changelog:` line, and end with `Fixes #2201`. Without that line the merge will not close the issue. The screenshot is not in the body: put the `after-preview.png` from the `screenshots` branch into the body. Note that the build banner in the picture reads `7f2d9bfc`, not this head. Take the picture again at the final head.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 106f4c314523541569c9513e090241f3a91be108 -->
Body re-check at the same head 106f4c314. The body blocker is cleared.
- The body says what changed, gives the frame-cost readings, names the pinning tests, says what was not exercised, carries the `Changelog:` line, and ends with `Fixes #2201`.
- The screenshot: one after image on the `screenshots` branch at `4a85a40e5`, named in the body with the note that it was taken at an earlier head. No before image: the change is a cache, and the pinning tests compare the cached lines with a fresh build. Accepted for a cache-only fix.
- The head has not moved, so the built review stands: ui lib 1208 pass, 0 fail; clippy clean on `camcraft-ui` and `camcraft-app`.
- The PR merges cleanly with `main` (`MERGEABLE`).
- The decision entry `docs/decisions/2201-toolpath-line-cache.md` is in the branch. The follow-up #2653 is filed and named in the body.

merge-ready.

Merge class: SAME. The head `106f4c314523541569c9513e090241f3a91be108` is the reviewed head. No commit came after the review, and the PR merges cleanly with `main` without a refresh.

This merge relies on the built review and the body re-check of this head (the two `pr-reviewer` comments of 2026-11-19, 01:07 and 01:13 UTC). The PR is not under the safety floor, so it needs no second review.
